THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
Area 5 · Overpass and flood
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

A rickety bridge crosses the passage high above the water. A small figure shifts against the shadowed ceiling. Farther upstream, the sound of pooled water presses through the cave.

The bridge's boards and supports stand out against the rock when your light catches them. Below, the stream continues along the climbing passage. The figure above and the louder water ahead give you two different things to watch as you decide whether to advance.

Ask the players

“Do you move under the bridge, try to reach it, or deal with the watcher first?”
